turning-point-christian-church-frederick.assessment: Turning Point Christian Church is a smaller non-denominational congregation on Canal Street in downtown Fredericksburg. Pastor Dr. Joseph Reed is a retired Marine Master Sergeant. The church streams services on Facebook and YouTube. Needs further research on theology, preaching style, and leadership structure.

score_notes.christology: 'Our Beliefs' affirms the Trinity — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit — and Jesus's death and resurrection as the basis of salvation.
score_notes.scripture: Beliefs page states 'the scriptures to be true, and free from error' and 'the entirety of the Bible is God breathed' — explicit inerrancy language.
score_notes.gender: Elder-led body stated; beliefs page does not specify male-only eldership, but traditional marriage/sex-at-birth stance signals complementarian trajectory.
score_notes.leadership: Live site references Pastor Joe Reed plus 'Elder Quinton' (with spouse Gine), confirming at minimum a 2-elder plurality structure. Distinct men's and women's ministries reinforce complementarian polity in practice.
score_notes.soteriology: Salvation through Christ's death and resurrection; believer's baptism by immersion stated.
score_notes.cultural: Traditional marriage affirmed: 'one man and one woman, as their sex was determined at birth' — explicit stance against gender ideology.
score_notes.preaching: Mission emphasizes apologetics training — likely topical/apologetics-oriented rather than pure expository.
score_notes.mission: 'Connecting the unconnected to Christ' — evangelism language; apologetics training emphasis.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Not stated on available sources — verify in person.
score_notes.denominational: Self-described unaffiliated body, but live site confirms elder plurality language and traditional men/women ministries; apologetics emphasis ('raise up the next generation of apologists') is substantive and conservative. Upgrade denominational from red to yellow: the rubric's red trigger was 'no external accountability AND no internal plurality' — internal plurality is now visible.
